label: accepted

evidence.V1: Reads as a standing banner from front, three-quarter and silhouette (finial, cross-bar, hanging cloth with tail, round base); top view still shows bar, finial and base disc clearly.
evidence.V2: Clear hierarchy: big = cloth panel, medium = star emblem, cross-bar, pole and stepped base, small = ball finials and the dark hem band.
evidence.V3: Confident stylised proportions: chunky gold finials and stepped base, gently waved cloth with a shallow pointed tail, slim pole; outline is centred on the pole (A15 X 0.0).
evidence.V4: Star, base rings and bar ends carry consistent soft chamfers that catch light; cloth edges are softly rounded rather than razor.
evidence.V5: Visible defect: a small triangular hole at the centre of the star emblem shows the cloth through it (clear in both studio and flat emblem close-ups); finial spheres also show a slightly faceted outline.
evidence.V6: One fabric hue in two values (cloth + darker hem), gold accents, wood-brown pole, ink base rim: disciplined.
evidence.V7: 1760 tris vs medium target 2000 / ceiling 4000: under target.
evidence.V8: Single LF_VertexColor material, gold #E8AE38-style fittings, ink base, kit chamfers; crimson and shadow colourways swap only the fabric hue.
evidence.V9: Anchored, CollisionFidelity Box, CanTouch off, MeshPart.Color white, SmoothPlastic, origin bottom-centre: correct.
